bio.text: Dave Seeman is an independent candidate for governor of Tennessee in 2026.
In a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire, Seeman reports an endorsement from the Green Party of Tennessee, a first run for office, and earlier work as a climate activist.

In the same questionnaire, Seeman lists the occupation as designer, engineer and business owner, a co-founded product design firm, and a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.
Seeman says Franklin is home town and Nashville is home now.
